content: वक्तव्य {%<ab>pot. p.</ab>%} [वच्-तव्य] .²1 Fit to be said, told, spoken or declared; तत्तर्हि वक्तव्यं न वक्तव्यम् (frequently occurring in <ls>Mbh.</ls>) .²2 To be spoken about. .²3 Reprehensible, blamable, censurable. .²4 Low, vile, base. .²5 Accountable, responsible. .²6 Dependent; कामवक्तव्यहृदया भर्तृनाथाश्चरन्ति याः <ls>Rām. 2. 117. 26</ls>. .{@-व्यम्@} .²1 Speaking, speech. .²2 A precept, rule, dictum. .²3 Blame, censure, reproach; एवमेतत् . वक्तव्यं परिहर्तव्यं च <ls>Pañch. 2</ls>; वक्तव्यं किञ्चिदस्मासु <ls>Pratimā 3. 6</ls>.
